name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the curve with parametric equations

$$
x=\frac{1}{2}{t}^{3}-2,\,y=\frac{t-1}{t+1},\,0\le t\le 5.
$$

Fill in the blanks in the following table of values:

| **$t$** | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-2$ | $-\frac{3}{2}$ | $2$ | $\frac{23}{2}$ | $30$ | {{field-1}} |
| $y$ | $-1$ | $0$ | {{field-2}} | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{3}{5}$ | {{field-3}} |

EXPLANATION

  • To find the value of x(5), we substitute t=5 into x=12t3−2. This gives x(5)=12(5)3−2=1252−42=1212.

  • To find the value of y(2), we substitute t=2 into y=t−1t+1. This gives y(2)=2−12+1=13.

  • To find the value of y(5), we substitute t=5 into y=t−1t+1. This gives y(0)=5−15+1=46=23.

Then the table is

t 0 1 2 3 4 5
x −2 −32 2 232 30 1212
y −1 0 13 12 35 23
